text_block_list.text:
It is the announcement day of my fan
results.
With many of my followers
having flocked to the
venue, the signal
of my advance is set to come!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
A beacon of smoke drifts into the sky.
Down with
the Golden Generation! With
sweat-drenched
fists clenched, I vow to
do battle with those
mighty foes!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Before this can be done, I must claim the
first of
the Classic Triple Crown races,
held atop the lush
greens of
Nakayama—the Satsuki Sho!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
